purge -- Purge records from catalog

USAGE
  purge [catalog=<catalog>]
  purge files [job=<job>] [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [client=<client>] [volume=<volume>] [yes]
  purge jobs [client=<client>] [volume=<volume>] [pool=<pool>] [jobstatus=<jobstatus>[,...]] [yes]
  purge volume[=<volume>] [all] [pool=<pool> | allpools] [volstatus=<volstatus>[,...]] [volume=<volume> ...] [storage=<storage>] [devicetype=<devicetype>] [drive=<drive>] [action=<truncate|all>] [dryrun | yes]
  purge quota [client=<client>] [yes]

DESCRIPTION
  Deletes catalog records without regard to retention periods. It needs full access to every resource.

  purge volume all (Onesimus extension) purges every volume of one pool (pool=) or of all pools the console may access (allpools) whose status is one of volstatus= (default Full,Used,Error). It is never interactive: dryrun only shows what would be purged, yes purges.

SUBCOMMANDS
  purge files
      File records
  purge jobs
      Job records
  purge volume[=<volume>]
      Volume records
  purge quota
      Quota of a client

ARGUMENTS
  purge
    catalog=<catalog>
        Catalog name (name; values from .catalogs)
  purge files
    job=<job>
        Job name (name; values from .jobs)
    jobid=<jobid>[,...]
        Job IDs (text; several values separated by commas)
    client=<client>
        Client name (name; values from .clients)
    volume=<volume>
        Volume name (name; values from .media)
    yes
        Do not ask (keyword)
  purge jobs
    client=<client>
        Client name (name; values from .clients)
    volume=<volume>
        Volume name (name; values from .media)
    pool=<pool>
        Pool name (name; values from .pools)
    jobstatus=<jobstatus>[,...]
        Job status letters (text; several values separated by commas)
    yes
        Do not ask (keyword)
  purge volume[=<volume>]
    volume[=<volume>]
        Volume name (name; values from .media; the value may be left out)
    all
        Every volume of the pool selection (Onesimus) (keyword)
    pool=<pool>
        Pool name (name; values from .pools; excludes the other arguments of group scope)
    allpools
        Every pool (keyword; excludes the other arguments of group scope)
    volstatus=<volstatus>[,...]
        Volume status (Onesimus); Purged and Recycle volumes are never selected, Cleaning tapes cannot be purged (one of a fixed set; values: Full, Used, Error, Append, Archive, Disabled, Read-Only; several values separated by commas)
    volume=<volume> ...
        Volumes for action= (several allowed) (name; values from .media; may be repeated)
    storage=<storage>
        Storage name (name; values from .storages)
    devicetype=<devicetype>
        Device type (text)
    drive=<drive>
        Drive number (number)
    action=<truncate|all>
        Action on purge (one of a fixed set; values: truncate, all)
    dryrun
        Only show what would be purged (Onesimus) (keyword; excludes the other arguments of group mode)
    yes
        Do not ask (keyword; excludes the other arguments of group mode)
  purge quota
    client=<client>
        Client name (name; values from .clients)
    yes
        Do not ask (keyword)

EXAMPLES
  purge volume=Full-0001 yes
      purge one volume
  purge volume all pool=Full volstatus=Full,Used dryrun
      show what would be purged (Onesimus)
  purge volume all allpools yes
      purge every Full, Used or Error volume (Onesimus)

ORIGIN
  Bareos console command.

SEE ALSO
  prune, delete, truncate
